context: L6 scale lookup (PLAN v3 rung 1). Reads reports/scale_final.json (per-image depth_pxcm, pitch_px, sector, chrome, run), re-fuses with tick units {0.1,0.2,0.25,0.5,1,2} within 12% tolerance, fills Siemens stills via a 5.75 cm footprint (sector_w/5.75), and on video-mode frames (sector x==0 or None) detects the left ruler's major ticks and OCRs the depth label / 'De NN mm' panel to get px/cm = tick span / depth_cm; then run- and chrome-consensus fills; writes reports/scale_v2.json. Debug run on 8 exemplars: 1200-wide video frames -> 148.1 px/cm (panel 50 mm, 5 intervals), IMG_00200 127.6 -> 159.5 (unit 0.25 -> 0.2), IMG_00002 footprint 152.0. Known gap: 644x1088 layout ticks not yet detected (label OCR drops the 5 of 50); that layout may stay unscaled this version. Review for correctness bugs, silent wrong-scale risks (e.g. a wrong tick count or OCR misread producing a confident bad px/cm), and the consensus logic.

errors.desc: `left-ruler` trusts any OCR depth in `20..120` mm and immediately computes `px_per_cm`, but never checks that the OCR depth is consistent with the detected major-tick comb, so a misread label can silently produce a confident wrong scale
errors.fix: reject or flag OCR depths that do not reconcile with `lr["n_intervals"]`/`lr["pitch_px"]` within tolerance and fall back to unlabeled-ruler or consensus instead.

errors.desc: the `chrome` consensus pass is seeded with values already filled by the earlier `run` consensus pass, so an inferred run value can be re-propagated as if it were a direct measurement across an entire chrome cluster
errors.fix: keep a separate set of measured-only seeds, or exclude `*-consensus` sources from later consensus passes.

errors.desc: a missing or unreadable image makes `cv2.imread` return `None`, after which `G.to_gray(...)` / `g.shape` will raise and abort the whole batch without identifying the file cleanly
errors.fix: check the load result before conversion and skip or fail with an explicit per-file error.
